method.sample_execution: No sample installed, imported or executed. AST parsing, version-matched marshal/dis, pickletools, static decoding, filefacts, Rizin and selected Ghidra decompilation were used.
method.source_review: Every source was indexed; activation and sensitive operations were traced. Identical hashes share review across variants. Candidate static call graphs are conservative and do not prove reachability.
method.native_review: Every native member was inventoried and signature/structural facts inspected. Selected entry points and sensitive routines were decompiled; exhaustive decompilation of all vendor/runtime code is not claimed.
method.unresolved_policy: Purgatory means quarantine/investigate and is not a finding of non-hostility. Missing external implementations and insufficiently established sensitive native flows were excluded from good data.
method.parse_anomalies: Four distinct AppleDouble resource-fork byte streams have .py names; one six-byte UTF-16 scripts/__init__.py in VidChain contains only a newline. These are not hidden executable Python bodies.
method.provenance: Independent release hashes, publisher signatures and vendor comparisons corroborate behavior review; neither a package name nor RECORD consistency alone proves trust.
